newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Novartis, Alexion in gene therapy accord.
newsitem.headline: Novartis, Alexion in gene therapy accord.

text.p: Novartis AG said its Genetic Therapy Inc unit signed an agreement with Alexion Pharmaceutical Inc covering development of immuno-protected genetic therapy products.
The arrangement gives Novartis exclusive worldwide rights to develop and market immuno-protected viral gene therapy products for direct in vivo gene therapy.
Alexion will in return receive upfront license fees, research payments and milestone payments totalling up to $10 million, in addition to royalties on future net sales of such products.

Alexion's proprietary technology has the potential of delivering gene therapy products inside the patient's body through mechanisms that are not attacked by the immune system. It successful the therapeutic agent will be delivered in a new generation of gene therapy products, Novartis said in its statement. -- Zurich Editorial +41 1 631 7340
